notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p7). Printed total revenues 4,047,827 include loan proceeds 400,000, recorded as debt_proceeds (receipts list excludes it). Proceeds from sale of assets 33,500 recorded in other_financing. Beginning fund balance 2,546,676 is the printed 'restated' amount (2024 ending total was 2,706,676; difference -160,000 is the restatement, not added as an adjustment because the printed roll-forward starts from the restated figure). 'Property and motor vehicle' tax line is combined and no breakdown is printed anywhere, so kept as taxes (unlabeled). ending_cash = cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds balance sheet total column (734,350; p5). Business-type from Proprietary Funds Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position total column (p10): reported receipts = operating revenues 7,396,122 + interest income 135,973; disbursements = operating expenses 6,978,353 + interest expense 130,048 + bond issue costs 46,575 (no single printed total). Proprietary cash flow totals from p11-12 Total Proprietary Funds column. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column excluding component units; noncurrent investments 4,084,801 categorized cash and investments. Detail: General Fund combining schedule (p20) recorded per department column (General, Fire, Ambulance, Cemetery, Park and Pool, Library, Airport, Economic Development), each with its function (General Fund column includes Police, kept general government); the General Fund budgetary comparison (p13-14) is not separately recorded to avoid double counting; its loan proceeds are shown as other financing inside the revenue total. Street and Sales Tax fund budget schedules are on a cash budget basis so amounts differ slightly from the GAAP statement (e.g. Street revenues 657,465 vs 658,662; Sales Tax 908,331 vs 939,950). The ALL FUNDS budgetary schedule (p17-18) combines governmental and enterprise funds; only its business-type function lines (Electric, Gas, Water, Wastewater, Ethanol plant; cash budget basis, no object breakdown) are recorded in detail, with no detail_totals entry since its totals mix fund types; its revenue, capital outlay, other and debt service lines mix fund types and are not recorded. Nonmajor funds recorded per fund (6 funds). Read pages 1-20 of 20. ending_investments = Investments 135,542 printed separately on the governmental funds balance sheet (p5, informational, not in ending_cash); the same page also lists certificates of deposit 106,065 and cash at county treasurer 44,043, which are in neither field. 'Grants' lines recategorized from donations/contributions to intergovernmental/state aid (review).
